entities.name: Query RlmN protein
observations: Sequence-derived length is 354 aa, not 534 aa as stated in the request.
Predicted molecular weight is 40.68 kDa; theoretical pI is 7.62; GRAVY is -0.404, consistent with a soluble protein.
Pfam detects RlmN_N (PF21016.4) at residues 7–64 and Radical_SAM (PF04055.28) at residues 108–279.
Closest reviewed homologs are RlmN proteins Q5WKB6, Q833B6, and Q8ELW7 with 68.9–71.6% identity, 98.6–98.9% query coverage, and E-values of 1.5e-177 to 1.3e-183.
Homology supports dual-specificity methylation of A2503 in 23S rRNA and A37 in tRNA.
The enzyme is inferred to bind one [4Fe-4S] cluster coordinated by three cysteines and to use S-adenosyl-L-methionine.
Likely localization is the bacterial cytoplasm; exact substrate specificity remains homology-based rather than directly experimentally established for this sequence.

entities.name: RlmN
observations: Reviewed bacterial RlmN homologs are EC 2.1.1.192 radical-SAM methyltransferases that methylate adenosine C2 in 23S rRNA and tRNA.
RlmN homologs bind a [4Fe-4S] cluster and use S-adenosyl-L-methionine.
Associated GO annotations include rRNA adenine C2 methyltransferase activity, tRNA adenine C2 methyltransferase activity, rRNA/tRNA binding, cytoplasmic localization, and 4Fe-4S cluster binding.

entities.name: RNA base methylation
observations: RlmN homologs participate in bacterial rRNA base methylation and tRNA methylation.
